description: Official share-count checkpoints and official ATM (at-the-market) sales between them, from Bitmine 10-Q filings (CIK 1829311). Used to anchor the reconstruction and to backtest the weekly estimator out-of-sample. Dollar figures in USD.

Repo roll-forward (trade-date Nov 30 anchor 408,578,823 + 84,960,590 ATM sold + 442,463 Jan 23 award vest) = 493,981,876, residual +76,649 (+0.016%) = 200,000 shares sold but unsettled at Feb 28 − 27,083 other stock comp − 94,518 warrants − 1,750.

checkpoints.note: Inconsistent with the same filing: Feb 28 count 493,905,227 + 57,107,586 ATM shares sold "subsequent to February 28, 2026 and through the date of issuance" = 551,012,813, i.e. 13.38M more than this cover figure. cash_flow_official.note: Quarterly figures (USD thousands) derived by differencing the year-to-date statements of cash flows / operations in the three fiscal-2026 10-Qs (fiscal year ended Aug 31). Bitmine reclassified option-contract cash flows from operating (6-month statement) to investing (9-month statement), so the Dec–May combined column is the cleanest.

staking_eth_units_9m.what: ETH received from staking, Sep 1, 2025 – May 31, 2026 (Note 4 roll-forward)

eth_cost_quarterly.description: Average price Bitmine actually paid per ETH, by fiscal quarter, from the 10-Q digital-asset roll-forward (Note 3/4: ETH units and cost basis; 'Additions from the purchase of ETH'). Units purchased = change in ETH units held − staking units (− units from acquisitions + units sold). Compared with the purchase-weighted average of the weekly average ETH price (weights = ETH added in each weekly release). factor = paid ÷ market. Used as the 'disclosed' ETH price basis for weeks inside a filed quarter; the pooled factor over all filed quarters is the 'assumed' basis after the last filed quarter.

quarters.derivation: Units: 3,737,140 held Nov 30, 2025 − 1,874,927 held Aug 31, 2025 − ~327 staking (=$980K staking additions ÷ ~$3,000). Cost: 'Additions from the purchase of ETH' $7,527,221K (cash paid in the cash-flow statement was $7,402,573K; the ~$125M difference was paid in December).
quarters.market_avg_source: Computed offline (no weekly releases before Nov 30, 2025 in releases.json): ETH added per weekly 8-K (Aug 31 → Nov 30, 2025 holdings: 1,866,974; 2,069,443; 2,151,676; 2,416,054; 2,650,900; 2,830,151; 3,032,188; 3,236,014; 3,313,069; 3,395,422; 3,505,723; 3,559,879; 3,629,701; 3,726,499) × that week's average daily ETH close (Yahoo Finance ETH-USD).

quarters.derivation: Units: 4,473,459 held Feb 28 − 3,737,140 held Nov 30 − ~3,780 staking (=$10,201K ÷ ~$2,700). Cost: 6-month additions $9,536,645K − Q1 $7,527,221K. Cash paid (cash-flow statement) was $2,134,422K: includes ~$125M for ETH added in November.

Units: 9-month purchases 3,518,278 (Note 4 roll-forward, exact) − Q1 1,861,886 − Q2 732,539. Cost: 9-month purchases $11,573,152K − 6-month $9,536,645K. Cash paid (cash-flow statement) was $2,150,498K; the 9-month cash paid for digital assets exceeds 9-month additions by $112.5M (not explained in the filing).

eth_cost_quarterly.next: 10-K for the fiscal year ended Aug 31, 2026 (not on EDGAR as of Oct 27, 2026): Jun–Aug 2026 = 12-month purchases − 9-month (3,518,278 ETH, $11,573,152K). Add it as a quarter here; those weeks then switch to 'disclosed'.

cash_timing_items.description: Cash paid for digital assets that is not the cost of ETH added in the same weeks (10-Q statement of cash flows 'Purchase of digital assets' vs the roll-forward additions). These are added to the weekly cash need as 'other digital-asset cash (10-Q)'. Each item is only used in the backtest from the date its 10-Q was filed (known_from).

items.what: Dec 2025–Feb 2026: cash paid for digital assets $2,134,422K − additions ~$2,009,774K (ETH $2,009,424K + BTC ~$350K): ETH added by Nov 30, 2025 but paid later (Q1 additions $7,527,221K − Q1 cash paid $7,402,573K = $124,648K). Payment dates not disclosed, so spread over the quarter's weeks in proportion to ETH bought.

Mar–May 2026: cash paid for digital assets $2,150,498K − additions $2,038,328K (ETH $2,036,507K + other digital assets $1,471K + BTC ~$350K). Not explained in the filing; timing unknown, so spread over the quarter's weeks in proportion to ETH bought.

cash_timing_items.after_last_filing: None assumed: over the three filed quarters together cash paid exceeded additions by only 1.0% ($11,687,493K vs $11,574,973K), and the 10-K for FY ended Aug 31, 2026 will show whether any Jun–Aug timing gap exists.
